series.name: US Shiller CAPE
series.measurement: Shiller U.S. cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings ratio (CAPE) from monthly workbook
series.notes: Official Robert Shiller monthly ie_data.xls; source workbook format may change, and redistribution rights require review. Not a global valuation measure.

series.name: ACWI global equities CAPE (Siblis free snapshots)
series.measurement: Siblis global equity ACWI CAPE calculated from index company filings; available as sparse historical month-end snapshots
series.notes: Siblis proprietary free-tier API, non-commercial research only. Nine sampled month-ends, not a complete monthly historical record. No automatic redistribution to GitHub Pages: separate permission/licence required. See https://siblisresearch.com/data-licensing/.

series.name: US BEA Q1: equity market value / replacement-cost produced assets
series.measurement: Bureau of Economic Analysis Q1: market value of domestic nonfinancial corporate outstanding equities / net stock of produced assets valued at current (replacement) cost
series.notes: Official BEA Survey of Current Business 2026 Table E Q1, historical annual 1960-2024; updated annually. Q1 is equity-only numerator and differs from BEA Q2 (adds book bonds) and Q3 (market bonds plus net liquid assets). Current-cost produced assets denominator is capital stock plus inventories, not market net worth. Does not extrapolate 2025 or 2026.

series.name: Global labour share of GDP
series.measurement: SDG 10.4.1 global labour income share as a percentage of GDP (ILO-custodied, distributed by UNSD)
series.notes: Only worldwide UN SDG SL_EMP_GTOTL geography 1, Reporting Type G and Age ALLAGE. Annual estimates are revisions, not listed-company profit share.

series.name: World output per hour / all-labour income per hour ratio (ILO identity)
series.measurement: GDP per total work hour / total labour income per same total work hour = 100 divided by ILO world labour income share (%) (SDG 10.4.1)
series.notes: Exact accounting identity, not two independently measured hourly series: using equal global hours denominators, GDP per hour / labour income per hour = GDP / labour income = 100 / world labour share percent. Labour income includes imputation for self-employed; it is wider than employee payroll, and must not be described as independently measured hourly wage growth. Annual changes measure the distributional wedge.

series.name: GDP-weighted international private credit-to-GDP gap (43 BIS economies)
series.measurement: GDP-weighted average of 43 country BIS private-nonfinancial credit-to-GDP gaps (actual minus one-sided HP trend) with prior-year nominal USD World Bank GDP weights. Excludes euro-area aggregate; published only when reporting countries comprise at least 80% of world GDP.
series.notes: Derived international credit-cycle composite, NOT a BIS-published world credit-gap series and NOT one global credit/GDP ratio passed through a global HP filter. Based on 43 independent economies excluding euro-area aggregate XM; observed 2024 GDP coverage 89.77%, 2025 89.72%. Nominal USD GDP from World Bank WDI NY.GDP.MKTP.CD and BIS WS_CREDIT_GAP Q.<country>.P.A.C; lag annual GDP by one year; refuse quarters with <80% world GDP coverage. A separate coverage series exposes coverage per quarter.

series.name: Live XAU/USD spot mid-price snapshot
series.measurement: Current indicative USD per troy ounce gold spot quote from Corgano (Swissquote bid/ask midpoint primary feed, fallback sources)
series.notes: Only the current live spot quote is available. Daily historical values advertised by this provider are COMEX front-month futures closes, NOT spot and must never be used for historical spot backfill. UTC as_of required; no public redistribution without upstream terms review.

series.name: 36-month gold / MSCI ACWI net-total-return correlation (USD)
series.measurement: Trailing 36 fully consecutive monthly Pearson correlation of USD monthly World Bank gold average returns and average daily MSCI ACWI USD net total-return index-level changes
series.notes: Genuine MSCI ACWI NETR index 892400; World Bank Pink Sheet nominal USD/troy ounce average. Both price and index measured as monthly mean levels before computing arithmetic monthly returns. Index levels include net dividend reinvestment under MSCI NETR; gold is monthly average commodity spot benchmark, not ETF or daily spot fixing. Only complete calendar months. Distinct from GLD/VT ETF proxy.

series.name: International government debt to GDP
series.measurement: IMF WEO DataMapper world general government gross debt, percent of GDP
series.notes: IMF DataMapper currently shows April 2026 WEO, not the later October 2026 WEO portal. Historical figures may be IMF estimates; current/future projection years excluded.

series.name: World Bank monthly gold price (USD per troy ounce)
series.measurement: Average monthly nominal gold price in USD per troy ounce
series.notes: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly average, not daily spot/total return. 1960 onward, workbook subject to monthly revisions, attribution required.

series.name: US credit-to-GDP gap
series.measurement: BIS credit-to-GDP gap, actual credit/GDP minus one-sided HP trend (CG_DTYPE=C); private non-financial sector, all lending sectors
series.notes: Country/area-specific BIS Basel III early-warning indicator. Cannot be summed into a legitimate worldwide gap; other CG_DTYPE codes are credit/GDP actual (A) or trend (B).

series.name: Euro-area credit-to-GDP gap
series.measurement: BIS credit-to-GDP gap, actual credit/GDP minus one-sided HP trend (CG_DTYPE=C); private non-financial sector, all lending sectors
series.notes: Country/area-specific BIS Basel III early-warning indicator. Cannot be summed into a legitimate worldwide gap; other CG_DTYPE codes are credit/GDP actual (A) or trend (B).

series.name: Japan credit-to-GDP gap
series.measurement: BIS credit-to-GDP gap, actual credit/GDP minus one-sided HP trend (CG_DTYPE=C); private non-financial sector, all lending sectors
series.notes: Country/area-specific BIS Basel III early-warning indicator. Cannot be summed into a legitimate worldwide gap; other CG_DTYPE codes are credit/GDP actual (A) or trend (B).

series.name: World real GDP per employed person growth
series.measurement: UN SDG 8.2.1 annual growth rate of real GDP per employed person, world aggregate, ages 15+
series.notes: ILO-custodied worldwide productivity growth. Does not represent wage growth or productivity-compensation divergence.

series.name: US nonfinancial corporate equities as % of net worth
series.measurement: Federal Reserve Z.1 nonfinancial corporate business, corporate equities as a percentage of net worth, level (NCBCEPNW)
series.notes: Useful US market-to-balance-sheet valuation proxy, NOT full Tobin's Q. Requires no replacement-cost assets assumptions. Source may make major quarterly structural revisions; public redistribution rights must be verified.

series.name: MSCI ACWI daily net total-return index level in USD
series.measurement: MSCI All Country World Index (large/mid cap developed and emerging markets), index code 892400, NETR USD official daily levels
series.notes: Genuine index net total-return levels. Not ACWI ETF price or vendor-adjusted close. MSCI public API history since 2000; prices may have holiday carry-forwards; no invented interpolation.

series.name: GDP coverage of 43-economy BIS credit-gap composite
series.measurement: Share of world nominal USD GDP in countries with a published quarterly BIS private credit gap; country GDP weights from previous calendar year. 80% threshold applied.
series.notes: This is a coverage diagnostic, not a credit-gap reading; never substitute it for worldwide total credit/GDP. Euro-area aggregate XM excluded to prevent duplication.

series.name: World capitalization of listed domestic companies (USD)
series.measurement: World Bank WDI world WFE-sourced market capitalization of domestically listed companies, annual USD, with variable country/exchange coverage
series.notes: WLD aggregate of reporting markets, not all listed corporations worldwide. Excludes funds and duplicated foreign listings under WFE rules; coverage/methodology changes and missing countries may affect trend.

series.name: World listed-equity market capitalization / world GDP
series.measurement: 100 × annual WDI world listed-market capitalization current USD / annual WDI world GDP current USD, same calendar year
series.notes: Derived ratio of two WLD level series; differs from WDI CM.MKT.LCAP.GD.ZS weighted country-share aggregate. Capitalization coverage is narrower than GDP and time varying. Both annual and current-dollar.

series.name: Siblis global equities aggregate trailing price/earnings
series.measurement: Global index capitalization / aggregate normalized trailing twelve-month earnings, source-published sparse December year-end 2016–2025 and September 2026 snapshots
series.notes: Proprietary non-commercial research data; no public redistribution. Publication is sparse dates only, not continuous 1970 history. Approximately 3,000 developed/emerging listed companies; normalized earnings and point-in-time valuation methodology. No combination with WDI capitalization for absolute earnings.

series.name: Siblis global equities normalized trailing earnings yield
series.measurement: 100 / Siblis world aggregate trailing P/E, normalized earnings as percent of that same index capitalization
series.notes: Sparse published year-end snapshots, not monthly historical coverage and not total global listed-company profits/GDP. Derived from the same universe's normalized aggregate P/E; proprietary, do not redistribute publicly.

series.name: MSCI ACWI top-ten index-constituent weight (dated public snapshots)
series.measurement: Original printed top-ten MSCI ACWI index security/share-class total from sparse primary factsheets; source as-of date retained separately from month-indexed storage and publication
series.notes: Canonical acquisition rebuilds primary factsheet printed totals from retained PDFs and immutable receipts. Rounded individual row sums can differ from the printed total. Historical data/msci_acwi_published_snapshots.json citations and all stored observations remain preserved; citation-only periods are not independently verified by a mutable URL. No interpolation, issuer consolidation or exact full historical membership is inferred. Rights may restrict redistribution.

series.name: EU27 financial and non-financial corporations gross operating surplus / GDP
series.measurement: 100 × (EU27 institutional-sector S11 + S12 gross operating surplus ESA2010 B2A3G in current millions EUR) / EU27 whole-economy S1 nominal GDP B1GQ (same year, euro)
series.notes: Corporations include listed and unlisted financial/nonfinancial businesses. No individual firm profits, net earnings, global aggregate, or self-employment household mixed income. EU27_2020 coverage; 2002-2025 matched years in first verified source response. Missing GDP years omitted, no extrapolation. OECD SDMX access refused by CI; this is an explicitly geographically narrower replacement.

series.name: EU27 non-financial corporation gross operating surplus / sector value added
series.measurement: Eurostat published gross profit share of non-financial corporations: 100 × (S11 B2G_B3G) / S11 B1G value added
series.notes: OFFICIAL profit-share ratio in corporate gross value added, NOT in GDP. Only EU27 nonfinancial corporations, not OECD/world and excludes financial corporations S12. Useful independent source cross-check on corporate profit margins and labour share.

series.name: GDP-weighted gross corporate operating surplus as share of GDP — OECD 38 members
series.measurement: GDP-weighted annual average of 38-current-OECD-member national ratios (S11 gross operating surplus B2G + S12 gross operating surplus B2G)/national GDP: OECD S1 GVA B1G + taxes on products less subsidies D21X31; for missing taxes only USA/JPN/CAN use same-year WDI nominal GDP LCU after currency and scale validation; weights are WDI nominal USD GDP by country/year
series.notes: Source OECD annual accounts for all corporate gross-surplus numerators; WDI nominal USD country GDP used for weighting, WDI local GDP denominator only for USD/JPY/CAD source-matched stable currencies USA/JPN/CAN lacking OECD product taxes. OECD 2026 38-member universe projected retrospectively; 25 accepted annual years (2000–2024). >=35 members with GDP weights, >=29 eligible full country components, >=80% OECD GDP weighting coverage. No extrapolation. Different from global listed-company net earnings and official OECD published aggregate.

series.name: Share of OECD 38-member nominal GDP with complete corporate-sector accounting
series.measurement: Nominal WDI USD GDP of current 38 OECD member countries with complete S11/S12 corporate gross surplus and national GDP (OECD GVA+net product taxes or restricted WDI local GDP denominator in USA/JPN/CAN) divided by GDP of OECD members with available WDI GDP weights, per year, times 100
series.notes: Coverage is share of GDP of OECD members for which WDI GDP exists, not global GDP; at least 35 of 38 weights required. Shares below 80% are excluded with the associated ratio rather than fabricated.

series.name: Contributing OECD member countries in corporate-surplus aggregate
series.measurement: Count of 2026's 38 OECD member countries entering the GDP-weighted annual corporate surplus aggregate; source numerator OECD S11+S12 B2G, denominator OECD GVA+product taxes or tightly validated WDI local GDP for USA/JPN/CAN only, and WDI USD GDP weight
series.notes: Country count is denominator coverage metadata; minimum 29 member contributors, 35/38 WDI country weights and 80% OECD-known GDP coverage. Fixed 2026 membership, not time-varying OECD accession membership.

series.name: US nonfarm business output per hour (2017=100)
series.measurement: BLS nonfarm business labour productivity (output per hour worked). Quarterly seasonally adjusted index 2017=100.
series.notes: Same nonfarm business scope as compensation, output deflator and labour share; includes employees and proprietors.

series.name: US nonfarm business nominal hourly compensation (2017=100)
series.measurement: BLS total hourly labour compensation, wages and benefits, nominal 2017=100.
series.notes: Deflate by matched BLS nonfarm business output price deflator for an output-price adjusted productivity comparison; not CPI purchasing power.

series.name: US nonfarm business value-added output price deflator (2017=100)
series.measurement: BLS value-added output price deflator for nonfarm business, 2017=100.
series.notes: Output price deflator, not consumer price index. Required for apples-to-apples hourly compensation and output comparison.

series.name: US nonfarm business labour share (2017=100 index)
series.measurement: BLS nonfarm business labour compensation as a share of current-dollar value-added output, indexed to 2017=100.
series.notes: This is an INDEX of labour share, not percentage points of GDP; do not label the 93 index level as 93% of GDP.

series.name: US nonfarm business hourly compensation deflated by CPI (2017=100)
series.measurement: BLS purchasing-power adjusted hourly compensation; CPI-deflated index 2017=100.
series.notes: Purchasing power and producer-output-price adjusted compensation answer different questions; avoid claiming either is a direct Marxian exploitation rate.

series.name: US labour compensation share of GDP (Penn World Table 11.0)
series.measurement: Penn World Table 11.0 share of labour compensation in GDP at current national prices, observed annual fraction (multiply by 100 for display as percent).
series.notes: Total-economy labour share annual ratio, not the BLS nonfarm business labour-share index; adjusted self-employed compensation follows PWT convention; source presently ends in 2023.

series.name: US Treasury 10y–3m yield-curve spread
series.measurement: FRED Treasury constant-maturity 10-year yield minus 3-month yield, daily percentage-point spread.
series.notes: Negative spread means inversion, not certain recession. US Treasury series, not global yield-curve signal.

series.name: Japan labour compensation as share of GDP (Penn World Table 11.0)
series.measurement: Penn World Table 11.0 share of labour compensation in GDP at current national prices, annual fractional ratio (multiply by 100 to display percent).
series.notes: Whole-country annual PWT concept through 2023; not an EU27/EMU aggregate, not the BLS nonfarm sector share or a Marxian surplus value rate.

series.name: Germany labour compensation as share of GDP (Penn World Table 11.0)
series.measurement: Penn World Table 11.0 share of labour compensation in GDP at current national prices, annual fractional ratio (multiply by 100 to display percent).
series.notes: Whole-country annual PWT concept through 2023; not an EU27/EMU aggregate, not the BLS nonfarm sector share or a Marxian surplus value rate.

series.name: France labour compensation as share of GDP (Penn World Table 11.0)
series.measurement: Penn World Table 11.0 share of labour compensation in GDP at current national prices, annual fractional ratio (multiply by 100 to display percent).
series.notes: Whole-country annual PWT concept through 2023; not an EU27/EMU aggregate, not the BLS nonfarm sector share or a Marxian surplus value rate.

series.name: Italy labour compensation as share of GDP (Penn World Table 11.0)
series.measurement: Penn World Table 11.0 share of labour compensation in GDP at current national prices, annual fractional ratio (multiply by 100 to display percent).
series.notes: Whole-country annual PWT concept through 2023; not an EU27/EMU aggregate, not the BLS nonfarm sector share or a Marxian surplus value rate.

series.measurement: Original BIS quarterly Private non-financial sector debt-service burden as percent of sector income
series.notes: BIS says cross-country DSR absolute levels are not directly comparable; assess within-country time movements or deviations. No world aggregate inferred.

series.name: DE Private non-financial sector debt-service ratio
series.measurement: Original BIS quarterly Private non-financial sector debt-service burden as percent of sector income
series.notes: BIS says cross-country DSR absolute levels are not directly comparable; assess within-country time movements or deviations. No world aggregate inferred.

series.name: CN Private non-financial sector debt-service ratio
series.measurement: Original BIS quarterly Private non-financial sector debt-service burden as percent of sector income
series.notes: BIS says cross-country DSR absolute levels are not directly comparable; assess within-country time movements or deviations. No world aggregate inferred.

series.name: PT Private non-financial sector debt-service ratio
series.measurement: Original BIS quarterly Private non-financial sector debt-service burden as percent of sector income
series.notes: BIS says cross-country DSR absolute levels are not directly comparable; assess within-country time movements or deviations. No world aggregate inferred.

series.name: PT Households and NPISHs debt-service ratio
series.measurement: Original BIS quarterly Households and NPISHs debt-service burden as percent of sector income
series.notes: BIS says cross-country DSR absolute levels are not directly comparable; assess within-country time movements or deviations. No world aggregate inferred.

series.name: US 10-year constant-maturity Treasury nominal yield
series.measurement: US nominal 10-year par constant maturity government Treasury yield
series.notes: Nominal rate, not actual total-return benchmark or real bond yield.

series.name: US 10-year TIPS-based inflation compensation
series.measurement: Nominal minus TIPS-linked 10-year rate, market breakeven inflation compensation
series.notes: Breakeven includes liquidity/risk premia; not a directly measured expectations-only series.

series.name: US high-yield option-adjusted credit spread
series.measurement: ICE BofA US High Yield Index option-adjusted spread in percentage points
series.notes: US speculative-grade corporate spread, a priced risk/liquidity measure; not US financial stress index or crisis probability.

series.name: CBOE VIX index level
series.measurement: CBOE VIX observed close, expected 30-day US equity option-implied volatility index
series.notes: Implied volatility level, not a long-horizon realized volatility or universal credit-stress indicator.

series.name: United States WEO average consumer price inflation
series.measurement: IMF WEO annual average consumer price inflation historical-year estimate
series.notes: WEO current-year and projection years intentionally excluded; previously published years may still be revisions, not original historical publication vintages.

series.name: Japan WEO average consumer price inflation
series.measurement: IMF WEO annual average consumer price inflation historical-year estimate
series.notes: WEO current-year and projections excluded; Japanese CPI definition differs from US.

series.name: China WEO average consumer price inflation
series.measurement: IMF WEO annual average consumer price inflation historical-year estimate
series.notes: WEO current-year and projections excluded; China CPI basket and revisions differ from other countries.

series.name: World Bank monthly Brent crude oil USD per barrel
series.measurement: Original Pink Sheet monthly nominal Brent crude oil average price, USD per barrel
series.notes: USD/barrel, not commodity total-return index or an identified exogenous oil supply shock.

series.name: BEA domestic nonfinancial business Q2 published replacement-cost valuation
series.measurement: Original 2026 BEA Survey of Current Business Table E Q2 replacement-cost Q published value
series.notes: Annual domestic nonfinancial business Q2/Q3, not a global Tobin's Q or a Fed equity/net-worth proxy. Each BEA Q definition has a different bond/liquid asset treatment.

series.name: BEA domestic nonfinancial business Q3 published replacement-cost valuation
series.measurement: Original 2026 BEA Survey of Current Business Table E Q3 replacement-cost Q published value
series.notes: Annual domestic nonfinancial business Q2/Q3, not a global Tobin's Q or a Fed equity/net-worth proxy. Each BEA Q definition has a different bond/liquid asset treatment.

series.name: US industrial production index
series.measurement: Federal Reserve industrial production index, seasonally adjusted
series.notes: Activity level; real industrial production, not country real GDP or a cycle prediction.

series.name: US unemployment rate
series.measurement: CPS U-3 official unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted
series.notes: Unemployment is backward/forward-looking depending on question; not itself NBER dating.

series.name: US quarterly real GDP level
series.measurement: BEA quarterly US real GDP chained-dollar volume level
series.notes: Chain-dollar base vintage matters; NOT an annual growth series; quarter periods are reference quarters.

series.name: US official NBER recession chronology monthly indicator
series.measurement: NBER-dated official US recession months carried in FRED 0/1 observations
series.notes: Ex-post announcements can occur much later than the original recession month; no hindsight-safe contemporaneous signal.

series.name: US nominal 2-year constant-maturity Treasury yield
series.measurement: 2-year constant-maturity nominal US Treasury yield
series.notes: Comparing levels requires tenor match; yield is not bond total return.

series.name: US nominal 3-month constant-maturity Treasury yield
series.measurement: 3-month constant-maturity nominal US Treasury yield
series.notes: Not Fed target midpoint; use original published observation period.

series.name: US wealth share held by the top 1%
series.measurement: Federal Reserve DFA net worth share 99th to 100th wealth percentile
series.notes: Percentage of household net worth, not financial asset share, income share or national GDP.

series.name: US wealth share held by the next 9%
series.measurement: Federal Reserve DFA net worth share 90th to 99th wealth percentiles
series.notes: Net worth is a stock; cannot conflate 9% wealth group with income groups.

series.name: US wealth share held by the middle 40%
series.measurement: Federal Reserve DFA net worth share 50th to 90th wealth percentiles
series.notes: DFA is a modeled integration of survey and Financial Accounts; revised historical shares.

series.name: US wealth share held by the bottom half
series.measurement: Federal Reserve DFA net worth share bottom 50%
series.notes: Very small group share; no inference to household consumption share or global population.

series.name: US current account balance as percent of GDP
series.measurement: IMF World Economic Outlook annual US current account balance divided by US nominal GDP
series.notes: Historical-year WEO estimates only; observations can be revised and are not dated release vintages.

series.name: Japan current account balance as percent of GDP
series.measurement: IMF WEO annual Japan current account balance in percent of GDP
series.notes: Trade, primary and secondary income make current account different from trade balance and NIIP stock.

series.name: Germany current account balance as percent of GDP
series.measurement: IMF WEO annual Germany current account balance percent of GDP
series.notes: National balances should not be summed as percentages; aggregation requires appropriate original GDP levels.

series.name: China current account balance as percent of GDP
series.measurement: IMF WEO annual China current account balance percent of GDP
series.notes: Reported national balance not national net foreign-asset position; country coverage/estimates vary.

series.name: property us real_residential BIS
series.measurement: Original BIS selected CPI-deflated real residential property price index, 2010 = 100
series.notes: Country-selected index; real/CPI-deflated values may be interpreted as changes, not direct house affordability. BIS world aggregate follows original available economy coverage.

series.name: property de real_residential BIS
series.measurement: Original BIS selected CPI-deflated real residential property price index, 2010 = 100
series.notes: Country-selected index; real/CPI-deflated values may be interpreted as changes, not direct house affordability. BIS world aggregate follows original available economy coverage.

series.name: property jp real_residential BIS
series.measurement: Original BIS selected CPI-deflated real residential property price index, 2010 = 100
series.notes: Country-selected index; real/CPI-deflated values may be interpreted as changes, not direct house affordability. BIS world aggregate follows original available economy coverage.

series.name: property pt real_residential BIS
series.measurement: Original BIS selected CPI-deflated real residential property price index, 2010 = 100
series.notes: Country-selected index; real/CPI-deflated values may be interpreted as changes, not direct house affordability. BIS world aggregate follows original available economy coverage.

series.name: property ea real_residential BIS
series.measurement: Original BIS selected CPI-deflated real residential property price index, 2010 = 100
series.notes: Country-selected index; real/CPI-deflated values may be interpreted as changes, not direct house affordability. BIS world aggregate follows original available economy coverage.

series.name: property world real_residential BIS
series.measurement: Original BIS selected CPI-deflated real residential property price index, 2010 = 100
series.notes: Country-selected index; real/CPI-deflated values may be interpreted as changes, not direct house affordability. BIS world aggregate follows original available economy coverage.

series.name: property us commercial_all BIS
series.measurement: Original BIS US all-properties quarterly nominal commercial property price index, 2010 = 100
series.notes: Commercial property indexes have country-specific covered area, asset classes, compiler and frequency. No global equivalence to selected residential data.

series.name: property pt commercial_all BIS
series.measurement: Original BIS Portugal whole-country commercial annual nominal commercial property price index, 2010 = 100
series.notes: Commercial property indexes have country-specific covered area, asset classes, compiler and frequency. No global equivalence to selected residential data.

series.name: US security broker-dealer financial assets
series.measurement: Total financial assets, level, US security brokers and dealers
series.notes: Published original Z.1/FRED sectoral balance-sheet data (millions USD, NSA). Not the assets of every US nonbank or global institution. Original first publication and revisions require ALFRED release metadata.

series.name: US security broker-dealer liabilities
series.measurement: Total liabilities, level, US security brokers and dealers
series.notes: Published original Z.1/FRED sectoral balance-sheet data (millions USD, NSA). Balance sheet liability stock not quarterly financing flow. Original first publication and revisions require ALFRED release metadata.

series.name: US security broker-dealer repo funding liabilities
series.measurement: Security repurchase agreements, liability stock, security brokers and dealers
series.notes: Published original Z.1/FRED sectoral balance-sheet data (millions USD, NSA). Repo liabilities are only one funding instrument and not an observed run probability. Original first publication and revisions require ALFRED release metadata.
